credit_policy: Each failed witness remains a retained operational negative with zero validation or completion credit. A bounded recovery never erases the failure.

records.failed_witness: The live global ghc-family-solo-activation skill path named by historical memory did not exist.
records.recovery: Use the fully read memory-backed copy as historical reference only and keep live roster, auth, index, and baton state authoritative.
records.passing_witness: The applicable current live skills and references were read completely and their hashes matched Vesper's guidance receipt.
records.recurrence_guard: Test a remembered skill path before treating it as live guidance.
records.rollback: No global skill or repository file was changed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Label memory-backed procedures historical when the live skill is absent.

records.failed_witness: PowerShell Measure-Object reported an unsafe 2511-line activation-baton count while later windows still contained content.
records.recovery: Count exact Git-blob newline bytes and continue bounded reads until an empty window beyond the true 3241-line EOF.
records.passing_witness: The exact blob contained 269393 bytes, 35015 words, 3241 lines, the expected SHA-256, and an empty post-EOF window.
records.recurrence_guard: Use raw committed bytes for long-file line, word, and hash contracts.
records.rollback: The unsafe line count received zero completeness credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Require a genuinely empty final read window before claiming EOF.

records.failed_witness: A combined authorization-state read exceeded the output envelope and truncated content.
records.recovery: Read each bounded line window separately through EOF and run the schema validator without an output file.
records.passing_witness: The complete state was read and the validator returned valid true for Lyren's owner-self-scoped delta.
records.recurrence_guard: Give large state files independent output envelopes.
records.rollback: The truncated combined display supplied no full-read credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Separate large guidance and state reads before validation.

records.failed_witness: A combined startup and closeout skill read was truncated by the output budget.
records.recovery: Reread startup and closeout independently through their exact line counts, then read orchestration in two bounded windows.
records.passing_witness: All selected SKILL.md files and required schemas were read completely.
records.recurrence_guard: Use one long skill per tool output.
records.rollback: The partial batch received zero complete-guidance credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not batch long orchestration guidance.

records.failed_witness: A manifest comparison looked for the sealed source-to-evidence manifest inside the evidence commit, although the manifest is introduced by the final seal commit.
records.recovery: Retain the successful generated component, read the sealed manifest from final, and compare every declared evidence entry to the evidence tree without replaying the component.
records.passing_witness: All 41 evidence paths, modes, Git blobs, sizes, and SHA-256 values matched with zero issues.
records.recurrence_guard: Distinguish a manifest's validation target from the commit that first stores the manifest file.
records.rollback: The failed wrapper comparison earned zero validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Read lifecycle placement before selecting a receipt commit.

records.failed_witness: A focused roster and authorization projection assumed nonexistent current_assignment keys and returned null fields.
records.recovery: Inspect actual top-level keys, then read current_variant, current_route, route, budgets, and terminal_truth explicitly.
records.passing_witness: The corrected projection bound Lyren v662-v5 to source 1605c722 and Ilyra Fen v662-v6 next.
records.recurrence_guard: Inspect real JSON keys before projecting current state.
records.rollback: The null projection changed no state and earned zero evidence credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Schema-derived projections are safer than remembered field names.

records.failed_witness: A content-seal consistency probe compared the final negative register through its pre-seal provisional field name.
records.recovery: Inspect the final register and compare effective_negatives_at_seal to the final seal.
records.passing_witness: Both sealed values were 23113 and failed_witnesses_erased remained zero.
records.recurrence_guard: Use lifecycle-specific final field names after a content-seal transition.
records.rollback: The stale projection earned zero consistency credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Do not project candidate-schema names onto final receipts.

records.failed_witness: The first branch preflight embedded a semicolon inside a PowerShell parenthesized command expression and failed to parse.
records.recovery: Execute show-ref separately and capture LASTEXITCODE in a scalar before building the result object.
records.passing_witness: The corrected preflight proved the target path, local branch, and remote branch were all absent.
records.recurrence_guard: Keep command execution and exit-code assignment as separate PowerShell statements.
records.rollback: The parser failure occurred before any mutation.
records.sibling_recommendation: Avoid compound command syntax inside expression parentheses.

records.failed_witness: The no-checkout worktree setup crossed the 30-second tool window after creating the branch but before index materialization.
records.recovery: Inspect branch, worktree, sparse config, and materialized files before continuing only the missing index initialization.
records.passing_witness: The branch remained at the exact source and all six literal sparse rules were installed before any tracked file materialized.
records.recurrence_guard: Treat timed-out worktree setup as indeterminate and inspect each substate before retry.
records.rollback: No duplicate branch or worktree was created.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use no-checkout plus state inspection for long Windows worktree creation.

records.failed_witness: A broad status on the no-checkout empty index rendered millions of characters of apparent staged deletions and exceeded the output budget.
records.recovery: Initialize the empty index from exact HEAD with git read-tree -mu under the existing sparse rules, then inspect only bounded status and literal materialized paths.
records.passing_witness: The sparse lane became clean with four materialized dependency files and zero Lyren-owned files.
records.recurrence_guard: Do not run broad status between no-checkout creation and sparse index initialization.
records.rollback: The apparent deletions were never committed or pushed.
records.sibling_recommendation: Complete sparse index initialization before any status rendering.

records.failed_witness: The first strict-JSON validation wrapper passed literal backslash-n sequences to Python -c and raised SyntaxError before reading any file.
records.recovery: Invoke the already-declared strict loader through a single-expression list comprehension with no multiline shell encoding.
records.passing_witness: All eight x1 JSON files parsed under duplicate-key-refusing strict semantics.
records.recurrence_guard: Avoid synthetic multiline source in shell -c wrappers when one expression is sufficient.
records.rollback: The syntax failure read no file, changed no state, and earned zero validation credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use a checked script file or a one-expression wrapper for strict JSON probes.

records.failed_witness: The first staged-review wrapper again placed a Git command and LASTEXITCODE assignment inside one PowerShell expression and failed to parse.
records.recovery: Run git diff --cached --check as its own statement, capture LASTEXITCODE in a scalar, and only then construct the review result.
records.passing_witness: The corrected review found exactly eight x1 JSON paths, zero x2 paths, zero privacy candidates, and clean diff hygiene.
records.recurrence_guard: Never embed semicolon-separated command and exit-code statements inside a PowerShell expression.
records.rollback: The parser failure occurred before staged content was read or changed and earned zero review credit.
records.sibling_recommendation: Use scalar status variables for every PowerShell command result.
